The '''battle near Airam Platform''' was a space battle between the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] and the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. It took place in deep space, likely within or very close to the [[Airam sector/Legends|Airam sector]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]], when Imperial [[Alpha-class Xg-1 Star Wing/Legends|Assault Gunboats]] attempted to disable the Rebel [[CR90 corvette/Legends|CR90 corvette]] [[Intrepid (CR90 corvette)|''Intrepid'']] near [[Airam Platform]], where rebel and Airam representatives were meeting.

==The battle==
The Empire, under the impression that the Rebel Alliance's ambassador to the Airam was an important enemy leader worthy of capture and interrogation, mustered a strike force of ''Alpha''-class Xg-1 Star Wings, better known as Assault Gunboats, to attack and disable the ''Intrepid'' as it departed Airam Platform. The Airam reacted coolly, only warning the Empire that if they passed within range of the [[XQ1 Platform]], they would be fired on. They dispatched [[Shiv Squadron]], a group of [[R-41 Starchaser]]s, to patrol the perimeter of the Airam station.

While the Airam looked on, the rebel VIP escort of [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|T-65 X-wing starfighters]] from [[Green Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Green Squadron]] sprang into action. They attempted to destroy the Assault Gunboats before they could disable the ''Intrepid'', as the rebel ambassador knew that the Airam had a [[Muurian transport]] with a repair crew aboard based out of Airam Platform in case the ship was heavily damaged. However, it was felt that the Airam would disrespect and never join the Alliance if they had to intervene in such a way. Meanwhile, the small Imperial force of [[Gamma-class ATR-6 assault transport|''Gamma''-class ATR-6 assault transports]] from [[Flight group/Legends|flight group]] Omega entered the area shortly after the Assault Gunboats, which had exited [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] a considerable distance from Airam Platform, began making their attack runs. Once they entered the system, they became the rebels' primary targets.

A handful of [[RZ-1 A-wing interceptor/Legends|A-wing interceptors]] from [[Gold Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Gold Squadron]] were apparently on standby near the battle zone, as the rebels had the option of calling for them to join the fight as reinforcements. Similarly, the Empire had several additional Assault Gunboats nearby that could [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperjump]] into the area if needed.

==Behind the scenes==
As players can participate in the mission "Ambush of Rebel Leader at Airam Platform" in the computer game ''[[Star Wars: X-Wing vs. TIE Fighter]]'' on either the Rebel or the Imperial side, both sides have conflicting mission objectives, and victory is not essential to access the next set of missions, the battle itself is considered canon but the canon outcome is unknown.

The ships listed in this article are those found in the battle [[Operation: Clean Sweep]], using the default craft assigned to the player.

This combat engagement apparently predated both the battle [[Balance of Power in the Airam Sector]], which is featured in the [[Star Wars: X-Wing vs. TIE Fighter#Balance of Power|expansion pack]] to ''X-wing vs. TIE Fighter'', and the campaigns [[Spreading the Rebellion]] and [[Task Force Vengeance/Legends|Imperial Task Force Vengeance]], all of which largely take place in the [[Airam sector/Legends|Airam sector]].
